root.note: Claude Code reaches the nested API configuration on demand. Codex builds its project chain through the launch directory, so from the root it never sees the nested files at all.

findings.title: API instruction missing in Codex
findings.detail: The API instruction is present for Claude, with no corresponding instruction in Codex's effective configuration.

findings.title: API skill has no Codex counterpart in scope
findings.detail: The target makes the nested Claude skill conditionally discoverable. Codex has not discovered the nested skill from this cwd.

api.note: Launching inside apps/api brings the nested files into Codex's chain too. Both harnesses now receive the same instructions and the same skills, so every compared entity is equivalent and nothing is reported.
